# rutter

> A personal memory layer for AI agents. One memory, multiple agents, yours. rutter
> keeps dated records in your own markdown notes folder, each with a content hash
> of the notes it cites. An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for six AI agent
> harnesses, often used for non-coding work too: Claude Code, Grok, Codex, Copilot
> CLI, Antigravity CLI (agy), and Muse Code; a personal reference implementation.

## Docs

- [Home](https://ruttermemory.com/): what rutter is, in one page
- [Get started](https://ruttermemory.com/getting-started.html): a setup path for each client (the Claude Code plugin, or npm as rutter-memory), from install to first recall
- [Docs](https://ruttermemory.com/docs.html): every page, in reading order
- [Why is it built this way?](https://ruttermemory.com/design.html): the design, and what each choice costs
- [How it works](https://ruttermemory.com/memory-of-use.html): memory-of-use, the record of how you used your notes: capture, recall, enrichment, note identity, positions
- [FAQ](https://ruttermemory.com/faq.html): how several clients share one memory, adding a client to a working setup, double capture, and missing records
- [From source](https://ruttermemory.com/from-source.html): set up Claude Code from a clone, for contributors
- [Manage and privacy](https://ruttermemory.com/manage-and-privacy.html): notice, pause, or remove capture, and what leaves your machine
- [Known issues](https://ruttermemory.com/known-issues.html): what is confirmed broken or untested

## Optional

- [Source hashes](https://ruttermemory.com/sources.json): content hashes of the docs this site was built from
